# Shivwik Holistic Care

> Physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic at 182, Ambica Vihar, Paschim Vihar, New Delhi 110087, India, founded and led by Dr. Sonal Khera Nagpal, BPT, MPT (Cardiopulmonary). Its specialty is cardiopulmonary rehabilitation: after a heart attack or cardiac surgery, for COPD, asthma or post-COVID breathlessness, and after an ICU stay. It also offers manual therapy, sports injury rehabilitation, pain management for back and neck pain and sciatica, post-injury rehabilitation, geriatric care, and antenatal physiotherapy with Garbhsanskar guidance.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 74074 46000
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM; Saturday 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM; closed on Sunday
- Appointments: https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/contact.html (online request with phone verification), by phone, or on WhatsApp
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/LDN7qMHyddyL3egG9
- Health articles on this site are reviewed by Dr. Sonal Khera Nagpal and are general information, not a medical assessment.

## Articles

- [Text Neck and Neck Pain: Simple Daily Habits for Relief](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/text-neck-and-neck-pain-simple-daily-habits-for-relief/): Learn how everyday screen habits contribute to text neck and discover simple, gentle habits to keep your neck healthy.
- [Understanding Frozen Shoulder: Stages and Physiotherapy Support](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/understanding-frozen-shoulder-stages-and-physiotherapy-support/): Learn what causes frozen shoulder, how its three stages progress, and how gentle physiotherapy can help restore your shoulder mobility safely.
- [Healthy Ageing: Simple Daily Movements to Stay Active](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/healthy-ageing-simple-daily-movements-to-stay-active/): Discover simple, gentle movement habits to help older adults maintain balance, strength, and independence every day.
- [Managing Lower Back Pain from Long Hours of Sitting](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/managing-lower-back-pain-from-long-hours-of-sitting/): Learn how long hours of sitting cause lower back pain, simple movement habits to ease discomfort, and when physiotherapy can help.
- [Kinesio Taping: What It Can and Cannot Do](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/kinesio-taping-what-it-can-and-cannot-do/): Understand the benefits and limitations of kinesio taping for pain relief and support.
- [Your First Physiotherapy Visit: How to Prepare and What Happens](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/your-first-physiotherapy-visit-how-to-prepare-and-what-happens/): Learn what happens during an initial physiotherapy assessment and how you can prepare for your first appointment.
- [Joint Stiffness in Winter: Staying Mobile with Gentle Exercises](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/joint-stiffness-in-winter-staying-mobile-with-gentle-exercises/): Learn how to keep your joints flexible during cold weather with simple exercises and tips to avoid stiffness.
- [What Is Manual Therapy? A Guide to Hands-On Physiotherapy](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/what-is-manual-therapy-a-guide-to-hands-on-physiotherapy/): Learn how manual therapy uses hands-on techniques to ease stiffness and support recovery, and what to expect during your physiotherapy session.
- [Ergonomics for Your Home Office: Avoiding Pain](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/ergonomics-for-your-home-office-avoiding-pain/): Learn how to set up your home desk and daily routine to prevent aches and pains.
- [Set Up Your Home Desk for Pain-Free Work](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/set-up-your-home-desk-for-pain-free-work/): Learn how to create a comfortable workspace and routine to prevent pain while working from home.
- [Recovering from a Stroke with Physiotherapy](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/recovering-from-a-stroke-with-physiotherapy/): Learn how physiotherapy helps stroke survivors regain mobility and independence.
- [Exercise Safely with Osteoporosis: Protect Your Bones and Stay Active](https://www.shivwikholisticcare.com/articles/exercise-safely-with-osteoporosis-protect-your-bones-and-stay-active/): Learn how safe, gentle exercises can help strengthen your bones, improve balance, and prevent falls if you have osteoporosis.
